## Invitations

A total of 656 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Of these, 230 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 35.1 per cent. This provides a clear indication of participation in the outreach activity and supports ongoing review of how invitations are issued and followed up.

The attendance result will help inform future outreach planning. The invitation process remains an important means of ensuring that people are aware of the service and have an opportunity to attend. Continued attention to engagement and follow-up may support participation across the Hill Counties area.

## Contact

SMS was used as part of the contact process for 577 invitations. A reminder message was also received by 577 people. These communications provided a consistent way to reinforce the invitation and support attendance.

Staff continue to phone people who missed two appointments. This follow-up remains part of the contact approach and provides an additional opportunity to re-engage people who did not attend. The combined use of invitations, SMS, reminder messages and telephone contact supports a coordinated outreach process.

Prepared by G. Evans.
